github.copilot.chat.commitMessageGenerat.text: Generate commit messages for this DSA practice repository.
Use exactly this format: solve: <4-digit LeetCode problem number> <official LeetCode problem name>
Always pad the LeetCode problem number to 4 digits. Example: problem 350 becomes 0350.
Use the official LeetCode problem title with correct capitalization.
Do not add a commit body, description, bullet points, emojis, scope, or extra text.
Example: solve: 0350 Intersection of Two Arrays II
